papers.title_en: UniGraph: A Unified Graph-based Index for Dynamic Hybrid Dense-Sparse Vector Retrieval
papers.authors: Keyu Chen, Xiaoyao Zhong, Jiabao Jin, Peng Cheng, Wangze Ni, Jingkuan Song, Heng Tao Shen
papers.evidence: 面向稠密-稀疏混合检索的统一图索引
papers.tldr: 混合稠密-稀疏检索通常分建稠密与稀疏索引再重排候选，存在两次检索和候选过早丢失问题。UniGraph 将多个混合权重下的邻居集合合并为单一有界度图索引，支持查询相关权重而无需重建索引，并配合权重引导入口与稠密优先剪枝搜索。实验在 Recall@100≥0.95 时取得更优 Recall-QPS 权衡，混合权重下 QPS 较最快基线高 27.6%~52.3%。该方法已在蚂蚁集团生产环境规模化部署，说明其对动态混合检索具有实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid dense-sparse vector retrieval combines semantic signals from dense representations with lexical signals from sparse representations, typically ranking items by a query-dependent weighted sum of dense and sparse vector distances. Existing systems commonly search separate dense and sparse vector indexes and rerank the union of their candidates, incurring two retrieval passes and potentially discarding items that rank highly only after the semantic and lexical signals are combined. Constructing a graph-based index directly under a hybrid distance can mitigate this premature candidate loss. However, because varying the hybrid weight alters the underlying neighborhood relationships, a single static graph built at a fixed weight cannot accommodate dynamic query-specific weights. Therefore, we propose a Unified Hybrid Graph (UniGraph), which merges neighbor sets computed at multiple hybrid weights into a single bounded-degree graph index, enabling hybrid vector retrieval with different query-specific weights without index reconstruction. We further develop an adaptive weight-guided search framework that chooses between sparse- and dense-guided entry points according to the query weight, together with a dense-first hybrid distance pruning strategy that avoids unnecessary exact sparse distance computations. Extensive experiments show that UniGraph provides a favorable Recall-QPS trade-off across different query weights. In the mixed-weight setting, UniGraph delivers 27.6%~52.3% higher QPS than the fastest baseline on each dataset at Recall@100 greater than or equal to 0.95. UniGraph has been deployed at scale in Ant Group's production environment, where hybrid retrieval with query-dependent weights is in strong demand.

papers.title_en: CapCover Filter: Semantic Approximate Membership Queries over Embeddings
papers.authors: Dvir David Biton, Shay Hahiashvili, Nadav Keren, Gil Einziger, Roy Friedman
papers.evidence: 向量库中免近邻搜索的几何过滤索引
papers.tldr: 向量库中SAMQ需在不漏检前提下快速拒绝无匹配查询，避免昂贵近邻搜索。CapCover Filter用球冠几何摘要嵌入集合，表示与查询阈值无关，一次构建支持任意阈值。五个真实数据集上，阈值0.95时过滤20–100%索引访问，仅用2% FP32内存；前置FAISS flat索引吞吐最高+382%、平均+116%，结果一致。该工作为紧阈值、昂贵检索和高聚类嵌入场景提供高效过滤并开源实现。
papers.abstract_en: Determining whether an embedding is sufficiently similar to any vector in a vector store without performing a nearest-neighbor search can substantially improve query throughput in vector-store systems. We study Semantic Approximate Membership Queries (SAMQs), which allow queries to be rejected when no indexed vector meets the requested similarity threshold, while guaranteeing no false negatives.   We introduce CapCover Filter, a geometric data structure that summarizes a set of embeddings using spherical caps. Its representation is independent of the query threshold, allowing a single filter to support arbitrary thresholds without reconstruction. We evaluate alternative construction and quantization methods, compare CapCover Filter with competing filters, and measure its impact on query throughput.   Across five real-world datasets, at a cosine similarity threshold of 0.95, CapCover Filter eliminates approximately 20--100\% of index accesses while using only 2\% of the raw (FP32) embedding memory. When placed before a FAISS flat index, it improves query throughput by up to 382\% and by approximately 116\% on average across the five datasets, while returning the same range-search result. We also evaluate lower similarity thresholds. Our results show that CapCover Filter can substantially improve vector-store throughput when similarity thresholds are tight, retrieval is expensive, and indexed embeddings are highly clustered. We release an optimized implementation of CapCover Filter and its evaluation framework.

papers.title_en: HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems
papers.authors: Chirag Goel, Jacob Lavoie, Amirhossein Naghshzan, Jordan Bannister, Marzia Nouri, Mehar Bhatia, Matt Harris, Siva Reddy, Arsène Fansi Tchango, Gaétan Marceau Caron
papers.evidence: 面向AI智能体记忆系统的整体评估框架
papers.tldr: AI智能体的记忆系统会持久保存用户信息，但现有评测只看任务表现与效率，忽视隐私、安全与用户主权等风险。作者提出HEAMS开源框架，把记忆系统的责任拆成性能、效率、安全、隐私、用户主权五类行为指标，并构建基准套件、MilaMem原型与可包裹任意记忆系统的治理层。跨系统对比显示，没有系统在所有性能基准上领先，高分性能常伴随较差的隐私与安全得分。结论是仅靠性能与效率基准无法判断记忆系统是否尽责。
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems allow AI agents to persist information across interactions, making them more personalized and more capable on long-horizon tasks. This persistence introduces new risks: stored information can be disclosed in inappropriate contexts, resist correction or deletion, be retained beyond what users desire, or be poisoned to influence later agent behaviour. Yet memory systems are typically evaluated on task performance and efficiency alone. We argue that a memory system should instead be understood as the custodian of its user's persistent information, with responsibilities that extend beyond helping an agent complete its tasks, and that it should be evaluated holistically against all such responsibilities. We present Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems (HEAMS), an open-source framework for evaluating agent memory systems in this way. First, we state the responsibilities of agent memory systems as explicit behavioural desiderata spanning performance, efficiency, security, privacy, and user sovereignty. Second, we assemble a benchmark suite that covers these desiderata and acknowledge the gaps that remain. Third, we develop MilaMem, a prototype memory system, and a governance layer that can wrap any memory system, enabling controlled study of memory system design choices. Fourth, we compare memory systems across the full HEAMS benchmark suite. We find that no memory system leads every performance benchmark, and strong performance scores may coexist with poor privacy, user-sovereignty, and security scores. Governance strongly influences results: recall policies can reduce inappropriate disclosure at a cost in helpfulness, while both recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance. Performance and efficiency benchmarks alone therefore cannot reveal how well a memory system meets its responsibilities. Code: https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams

papers.title_en: AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents
papers.authors: Runzhe Wang, Huilin Lu, Shengjie Liu, Li Dong, Zhihuai Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向长程智能体的跨任务程序性记忆设计
papers.tldr: 跨任务记忆并非越多越好：实验显示，朴素累积经验会让智能体在八个 AgentBoard 领域中的七个上不如无记忆的 ReAct。AdMem 让智能体在行动前先声明预期结果，再由并行的 critic 对照实际结果打分，把信用精确归给具体动作，并写入包含二元奖励与反思的过程条目。每条记忆还维护一个可在线更新的效用值，该效用值与上下文相似度共同决定检索排序，并驱动淘汰与合并。在 707 个任务上，AdMem 解出 441 个，显著超过 ReAct 的 388 个和工作流归纳基线的 312 个。
papers.abstract_en: An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.

papers.title_en: Orbit AI: Evaluating Tool-Augmented Agents For Enterprise Question Answering
papers.authors: Rishabh Gupta, Uday Kharatmol, Krishna Bhatt, Avadhesh Nagar, Naman Sanotiya, Tarun Jain
papers.evidence: 基于工具的检索增强生成系统评测
papers.tldr: 企业信息分散在文档、任务系统和团队对话中，问答需跨源检索。论文评估 Orbit AI：基于 LangGraph 的 ReAct 智能体调用三类工作区工具进行 RAG。80 题留出集上，Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite 完整智能体达 86.25%，仅文档 RAG 为 60.00%，无检索 LLM 仅 23.13%；多源题提升 43.75 个百分点。结果表明多工具智能体明显优于单源 RAG，但 Llama 本地实验受模型与部署差异影响，结论需谨慎。
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise information is commonly stored across multiple platforms rather than in one centralized location. Answering questions about workplace activities may require information from several sources, including project documents, task management systems, and team conversations. Therefore, we evaluate Orbit AI, a tool-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that uses a ReAct agent implemented with LangGraph to retrieve and combine information from three different workspace sources. We compare three configurations: (1) a standalone LLM without retrieval, (2) document-based RAG, and (3) a multi-tool agent with access to all three sources.   The held-out evaluation set contains 80 questions designed for Phase 3 workspace; Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite achieves an accuracy of 86.25% with the complete agent. Document-only RAG achieves 60.00% (26.25 pp higher), and the plain LLM achieves 23.13%. For multi-source questions, the full agent answers 84.38%, while document-only RAG answers 40.63%, a 43.75 pp increase.   The evaluated Llama 3.2 configuration with local inference achieves 5.50% overall correctness under rubric v2.2. The Llama 3.2 full-agent configuration achieves a held-out accuracy of 52.50%, which is 1.88 pp higher than the accuracy of document-only RAG. The gain of Gemini is equivalent to 26.25 pp. The comparison must be taken with a pinch of salt, because Gemini was accessed via an API hosted by them, while Llama was run locally via Ollama and the models are of different size. It is therefore not possible to isolate the cause of the performance gaps in this experiment. The paper also addresses the constraints of the evaluation such as the small artificial workspace and the similarity of the Q53 problem to a problem in the system prompt.

papers.title_en: Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents
papers.evidence: 衡量智能体行为一致性的评估框架
papers.tldr: 社会部署的 AI 智能体行为一致性缺乏评估保障。本文提出行为保障评估框架，沿五个可测维度刻画行为，用覆盖六类社会交互场景的标准化评测集，检验行为区分度、一致性与漂移。初步分析显示不同人格配置可测区分，行为画像与交互结果相关。工作将焦点从人格设计转向行为保障。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. Preliminary analyses demonstrate measurable differentiation across configurations and suggest associations between behavioral profiles and interaction outcomes. By shifting the focus from persona design to behavioral assurance, this work provides a foundation for evaluating whether socially deployed AI agents behave as intended, consistently and measurably, across the situations in which users encounter them.

papers.title_en: Bioformer-RetroMAE: retrieval-oriented pretraining of a compact biomedical language model for literature search
papers.evidence: 面向生物医学文献检索与RAG的稠密检索编码器
papers.tldr: 生物医学稠密检索依赖BERTBase编码器，索引成本高且MLM未显式优化[CLS]。作者用RetroMAE在约3200万PubMed标题摘要上继续预训练43M的Bioformer8L，并以BM25硬负例微调双编码器。BioASQ 12B全PubMed检索中，它以约40%参数和512维向量优于BioBERT/PubMedBERT，较PubMedBERT MAP提升37.0%；RetroMAE使原模型MAP提升53.6%。与BM25融合亦优于对比模型。
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrieval is increasingly used for biomedical literature search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Most biomedical bi-encoders are built on BERTBase-sized encoders pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). These encoders are costly for corpus-scale indexing and latency-sensitive query encoding, and MLM does not explicitly train the [CLS] vector that a bi-encoder uses to represent a whole text. We present Bioformer-RetroMAE, a compact (43M-parameter) retrieval-oriented biomedical encoder obtained by continually pretraining Bioformer8L} with RetroMAE on approximately 32 million PubMed titles and abstracts. After bi-encoder fine-tuning with BM25 hard negatives, we evaluated it on BioASQ Task 12B test questions by retrieving from all PubMed abstracts. Bioformer-RetroMAE outperformed BioBERT and PubMedBERT bi-encoders fine-tuned under identical settings on all metrics, despite having about 40% of their parameters and producing 512-dimensional rather than 768-dimensional vectors. Compared with PubMedBERT, it improved mean average precision (MAP) by 37.0% and Recall@100 by 29.1%. Compared with the original Bioformer8L}, RetroMAE pretraining improved MAP by 53.6% and Recall@100 by 32.8% without changing model size or inference cost. In hybrid retrieval, fusing Bioformer-RetroMAE with BM25 through weighted reciprocal rank fusion improved MAP and NDCG@10 over BM25 alone by 4.9% and 4.6%, respectively, larger gains than those obtained by fusing BM25 with PubMedBERT or BioBERT.

papers.title_en: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体长期记忆的权重参数化整合方法
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆靠抽取文本并检索，模型权重不变，误差累积且构建成本随对话增长；服务期微调则需反向传播、长历史下退化。CLAM 用循环超网络做参数化巩固：单次前向把会话激活编译成低秩适配器，无需梯度步与生成调用，并用定长门控隐状态跨会话传递知识，辅以逐字情节缓冲。在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上，三个 2-7B 开源模型上领先智能体基线 1-45 分、领先梯度式方法 10-45 分，构建耗时少 3-151 倍。两通道互补，缓冲未命中时适配器仍补 12-15 分。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.

papers.title_en: From Vision to Interaction: Evaluating Dynamic Social Intelligence of VLM Agents in ALIVE-World
papers.authors: Yue Xu, Xiaoyu Qin, Sihan Zhao, Ze-en Xiong, Jia Jia
papers.evidence: 评估VLM智能体的具身仿真基准
papers.tldr: 现有社会智能评测多将社交能力拆成文本推理或静态具身任务，难以刻画多模态、连续的人际互动。作者提出ALIVE-World具身仿真环境与ALIVE-Bench基准，用双系统对手智能体提供社会反馈，从感知、理解、影响与结果四维度评估VLM智能体。实验发现动态社会智能具有多维度和场景依赖性，上游感知与下游干预之间存在瓶颈，并暴露近距感知、自适应干预和多方可协调短板。该工作为多模态智能体的行为对齐提供了可量化平台与诊断依据。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications and take on social roles, dynamic social intelligence, the ability to continuously perceive multimodal cues, infer latent cognitive states, intervene through embodied actions, and ultimately achieve social goals, has become essential. However, existing evaluations largely fragment social intelligence into text-based abstractions, static reasoning tasks, or embodied simulators that lack social dynamics. These approaches fail to capture the multimodal, continuous, and interpersonal complexity of authentic human interactions. To bridge this gap, we introduce ALIVE-World, an embodied simulation environment supporting dynamic multimodal interactions encompassing egocentric vision, language, and non-verbal action. To provide socially grounded interactive feedback, we populate this environment with counterpart agents driven by a profile-conditioned, dual-system (intuitive-affective and logical-cognitive) architecture. Building upon this platform, we propose ALIVE-Bench to transform the assessment of social intelligence into a trackable quantitative framework. By deeply leveraging underlying environmental states and agents' internal variables, ALIVE-Bench systematically evaluates Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents across four critical dimensions: perception, understanding, influence, and outcome. Extensive evaluations reveal that dynamic social intelligence is fundamentally multi-dimensional and scenario-dependent. We identify a critical bottleneck between upstream perception and downstream social intervention, exposing VLM vulnerabilities in fine-grained proxemic awareness, adaptive intervention, and multi-party coordination. By uncovering these limitations and the diverse interaction strategies they produce, this benchmark provides actionable insights for the future behavioral alignment of multimodal agents.

papers.title_en: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
papers.authors: Ruizhe Li, Licheng Zhang, Mingxuan Du, Zhendong Mao
papers.evidence: 面向智能体记忆检索的效用排序方法
papers.tldr: 智能体记忆检索常依赖与问题的相似度，但真正有用的记忆未必与问题相似。Jetriever 改用 Jev 决策分数对全量记忆池按效用排序，以替代相似度检索。在 InMind 125 个间接查询任务上，金标交换首位命中率达 84.8%，BM25 与 MiniLM 对照仅 1.6% 和 0.0%。在 MemoryAgentBench 60 题上四维得分 55.4%，高于 ReFind 的 44.3%，并展示可负担的全池评分成本。
papers.abstract_en: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.

papers.title_en: Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World
papers.evidence: 有限预算下的智能体记忆更新机制
papers.tldr: 物理环境配置持续变化，场景记忆需在有限更新预算下写入新事实并保留旧有效信息。作者用冻结4B语言模型加后层LoRA，在四字段合成语义配置上联合评估纠错与保持。预算从8增至32时，两种变化历史条件联合成功率由6.25%升至94.79%和91.15%，过时值输出降为零；恒定训练条件后期仅85.42%。这表明小预算可快速纠错，继续训练可实现新旧事实同时正确，为场景记忆更新提供量化依据。
papers.abstract_en: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. In two exposure-matched history conditions, increasing the budget from eight to 32 updates raises joint success from 6.25% to 94.79% and 91.15%, respectively, while exact obsolete-value outputs fall from 174/192 and 166/192 to zero. Constant32, which matches preparation steps but repeatedly trains on unchanged content during the first 32 events, achieves higher early joint success at eight steps (53.65%); at 32 steps, it reaches 85.42%, below both changing-history conditions. These results distinguish rapid correction under a small budget from simultaneous correctness of the new fact and the other three facts after further training. For both changing histories, most cases remain jointly correct at all subsequent measured points from step 16 onward. Output analysis shows that short-budget failures primarily retain the old value; repeated training on the new fact together with the other current facts progressively replaces these obsolete answers.

papers.title_en: GRASP: Query-Adaptive Graph Retrieval framework with Cross-Attention Scoring and Path Sufficiency Verification for Question Answering
papers.authors: Rui Xu, Le Wang, Tianyue Wang
papers.evidence: 面向检索增强生成的查询自适应图检索与证据充分性验证
papers.tldr: 图结构知识图谱上的RAG检索需同时决定候选边评分、遍历终止与证据充分性。GRASP用跨注意力评分建模查询词与候选边交互，以学习式停止门按查询、遍历状态和跳数自适应终止，并用充分性分类器在生成前校验路径、不足时重检索。在三个生物医学问答基准上，其不支持声明率降低8.9%至13.2%，高候选密度下检索增益更明显。消融显示三组件互补，为图检索RAG提供查询自适应的一体化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval quality is a key factor in the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), particularly when retrieval is performed over structured knowledge graphs. Graph-based retrieval requires decisions about candidate-edge scoring, traversal termination, and the sufficiency of the retrieved evidence. We propose GRASP, a query-adaptive graph retrieval framework that jointly addresses these decisions during the retrieval process. A cross-attention scorer models fine-grained interactions between individual query tokens and candidate edges, providing query-specific signals for edge selection. A learned stopping gate conditions traversal termination on the query, traversal state, and hop depth, allowing the retrieval depth to adapt to the current retrieval state. A sufficiency classifier further evaluates the assembled path before generation and triggers re-retrieval when the evidence is predicted to be incomplete. We evaluate GRASP on three biomedical question-answering benchmarks with different graph scales and answer lengths, using biomedical question answering as a representative setting for evaluating graph-based RAG retrieval. GRASP consistently improves over the strongest learned baseline across the evaluated retrieval and generation metrics. The unsupported-claim rate is reduced by 8.9% to 13.2% across the three benchmarks, with the largest reduction on the benchmark with the longest generated answers. The retrieval gains are more pronounced under higher candidate density, while ablation results indicate that the three components provide complementary improvements.

papers.title_en: VAHBench: A Harness Benchmark for Agentic Long-Video Generation
papers.authors: Hongbo Zhang, Liuyang Song, Hang Zhou, Xinchen Liu, Wei He, Kai Han, Yunhe Wang
papers.evidence: 评估自主智能体长视频生成能力的基准
papers.tldr: 针对AI智能体能否把人类需求转化为完整视频，作者提出VAHBench长视频生成基准。它用五个短剧任务考察规划与制作，并从完整性、基础质量、制作可靠性和报告准确性评估。240次运行覆盖48种通用与视频专用智能体配置，发现高质量分数不等于更完整交付，缺集、重复镜头和静态填充暴露执行断点。该基准揭示从生成视频文件到满足需求之间的差距，并定位失败环节。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are commonly used for everyday information retrieval and coding. We ask whether they can also interpret human requests and turn them into complete videos. We introduce VAHBench, a benchmark that tests this ability through five short-drama briefs specifying story, characters, dialogue and duration. Agents plan and carry out production using shared generation tools. Evaluation combines video completeness and basic quality with checks of production reliability and reporting accuracy. Across 240 runs covering 48 configurations of general-purpose and video-specific agents, higher quality scores do not necessarily mean more complete delivery. Missing episodes, repeated footage and static filler reveal gaps between producing a video file and fulfilling the brief. Added composition tools help some agents but do not consistently improve performance. VAHBench measures how well agents translate user intent into finished video content and helps identify where that process breaks down.

papers.title_en: Leveraging Binary Hashing for Scalable Index Assignment in Semantic Communications
papers.authors: Leonardo Roque, Kuangyun Zhu, Louis-Adrien Dufrène, Quentin Lampin, Grégoire Lefebvre, Mohamad Assaad
papers.evidence: 二值哈希索引将嵌入压缩为码字并用汉明距离检索
papers.tldr: 语义嵌入在数字信道传输时比特开销高，传统向量量化又受可扩展性、编码复杂度和索引分配限制。本文把信息检索中的二值哈希引入语义通信，比较随机LSH与PCA、CCA、ITQ变体，在BSC上经汉明检索重建并做下游分类。MTEB和Banking77实验显示，数据依赖哈希优于随机LSH，ITQ精炼提升抗噪性，CCA-ITQ在测试信道条件下分类最优。结果表明二值哈希可作为可扩展的量化替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: Transmitting semantically structured embedding vectors over digital channels is costly in bit rate, while conven- tional vector quantization approaches face limitations in scalabil- ity, encoding complexity, and index assignment. This paper inves- tigates binary hashing techniques from the information retrieval literature as semantic indexing strategies for general-purpose networks. We study random Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) along with Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-, Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA)-, and ITQ (Iterative Quantization)- based variants in a semantic communication pipeline over a Binary Symmetric Channel. Embeddings are compressed into binary codes, reconstructed through Hamming retrieval from a shared table, and evaluated on downstream classification. Ex- periments on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) and the Banking77 dataset show that data-dependent hashing improves upon random LSH, while ITQ refinement increases robustness to channel noise. Among the evaluated methods, CCA- ITQ achieves the best classification accuracy across the tested channel conditions. These results indicate that binary hashing is an efficient and scalable alternative to quantization-based embedding compression for semantic communications.
